[Act: cpc
 Chapter: Execution of Decrees and Orders
 Section: O21R97::Resistance or obstruction to possession of immovable property.
]


Resistance of delivery of possession to decree-holder or purchaser
(1) Where the holder of a decree for the possession of immovable property or the purchaser of any such property sold in execution of a decree is resisted or obstructed by any person in obtaining possession of the property, he may make an application to the Court complaining of such resistance or obstruction.
6[(2) Where any application is made under sub-rule (1), the Court shall proceed to adjudicate upon the application in accordance with the provisions herein contained.]
